fact: The report records that Zambia enacted a Cyber Security Act and Cyber Crimes Act, that the Zambia Police Service recorded 874 cyber-related cases between 1 January and 30 June 2025, and that in December 2025 an influencer was sentenced to 18 months under the earlier 2021 Act.
title: Londa 2025 Digital Rights and Inclusion in Africa Report: Zambia
